Detailed dark eyes, naturally defined eyebrows, soft lips, subtle bindi, realistic facial proportions. Long, thick, naturally wavy dark hair, parted near the center and flowing over the shoulders. Every strand should be individually suggested using ultra-fine pencil lines. Her upper body is elegantly angled slightly to the side. One hand is raised naturally near her chin with relaxed fingers and carefully rendered fingernails. Portrait composition centered on the woman, with the head and upper torso dominating the frame. Maintain the graceful proportions and elegant posture.

Extremely sophisticated micro-thin color pencil drawing, hand-rendered illustration, ultra-fine sharpened colored-pencil strokes, delicate cross-hatching, layered pencil textures, precise contour lines, subtle stippling, controlled tonal transitions, intricate textile detailing, individually rendered hair strands, realistic skin shading, and fine botanical details. The image should look like an exceptionally skilled artist spent many hours creating it with microscopic pencil strokes.

Warm off-white textured drawing paper, with subtle hand-sketched pastel pencil washes in muted sage green, dusty blue, beige, and warm peach surrounding the portrait. Keep the background soft, minimal, airy, and slightly imperfect like authentic traditional paper artwork.
Lighting & Detail:
Soft natural illumination translated entirely through pencil shading. Extremely high detail, crisp fine-line work, delicate highlights, realistic depth created through pencil layering, no harsh digital gradients.
Technical:
Vertical 4:5 composition, centered portrait, ultra-high resolution, extremely sharp micro-details, authentic colored-pencil-on-paper appearance, sophisticated Indian fashion portrait illustration.
